lock_timing: After the frozen three-case development gate passed and before inspection of any v1 or v2 future metric on the remaining 19 cases.
status: Exploratory on the previously examined released PhysTwin cohort.
claim_boundary: This run can justify an independent preregistered evaluation, but cannot itself establish a SOTA claim.

development_gate.maximum_case_regression: 0.96 percent CD on double_stretch_sloth; below the locked 5 percent limit

primary_comparisons: raw teacher-centered MatPhys versus raw released PhysTwin
teacher-centered MatPhys plus frozen Bayesian overlay versus released Bayesian-PhysTwin selected stack
secondary_comparisons: absolute MatPhys v1 versus teacher-centered MatPhys v2
observed-prefix adaptive family policy, explicitly not treated as independent validation

acceptance_gate.transfer: Improve both equal-case CD and track error over the released selected stack on the 19 new cases.
acceptance_gate.stability: Win or tie both metrics in at least 12 of 19 new cases and have no regression larger than 10 percent in either metric.
acceptance_gate.frontier: Reduce at least half of the remaining equal-case gap from released Bayesian-PhysTwin to the published MatPhys reference in both metrics.
acceptance_gate.calibration: Do not claim calibrated uncertainty until NEES and coverage are recomputed for the new deterministic backbone.

next_evidence_rule: Proceed to an independent preregistered cohort only if transfer, stability, and frontier gates all pass.
